key_points: LifeMD partnership brings virtual-health benefits to ~29M AT&T customers, a genuine diversification move beyond core telecom
AT&T's free healthcare perk launch could improve customer retention and attract new subscribers
UBS rated AT&T a strong buy among lagging tech names, signaling contrarian institutional interest
AT&T's infrastructure expansion (Cowboys stadium deployment) reinforces network investment narrative
None of these headlines are thesis-changing; combined effect is modestly positive but incremental
